TERMS AND CONDITIONS

Effective Date: November 2026

1. INTRODUCTION

Welcome to PRIMETURN.

These Terms and Conditions govern your access to and use of the PRIMETURN website, platform and associated services.

By registering an account, accessing our website or using any of our services, you acknowledge that you have read, understood and agreed to comply with these Terms and Conditions.

PRIMETURN is committed to maintaining a secure, transparent and responsible platform for all registered members.

We reserve the right to modify, update or amend these Terms and Conditions whenever necessary to improve our services, strengthen security or comply with applicable Nigerian laws and regulations.

2. ACCOUNT REGISTRATION AND SECURITY

Every member is responsible for providing accurate, complete and valid information during registration.

Members must:

  • Provide genuine personal information during account registration.
  • Keep their login details, passwords and verification information confidential.
  • Avoid sharing their account access with unauthorised individuals.
  • Notify PRIMETURN immediately if they suspect unauthorised access to their accounts.
  • Ensure that their accounts are not used for fraudulent or unlawful activities.

PRIMETURN shall not be responsible for losses arising from a member voluntarily sharing their login credentials or failing to take reasonable steps to secure their account, except where applicable law provides otherwise.

3. PROHIBITED ACTIVITIES

PRIMETURN operates a strict policy against fraudulent, deceptive and unlawful activities.

The following activities are strictly prohibited:

  • Money laundering or attempting to conceal the source of illegally obtained funds.
  • Using the platform to receive, transfer or process proceeds of criminal activities.
  • Identity theft, impersonation or fraudulent account registration.
  • Using stolen bank accounts, cards or financial information.
  • Attempting to manipulate transactions or exploit platform operations.
  • Engaging in fraudulent purchases, payments or withdrawals.
  • Using the platform to finance illegal activities.
  • Participating in activities that violate applicable Nigerian financial laws.

Any member found to be involved in fraudulent activities may have their account suspended, restricted or permanently terminated.

Where necessary, PRIMETURN may preserve relevant records and report suspected unlawful activities to appropriate regulatory or law-enforcement authorities.

4. ANTI-MONEY LAUNDERING POLICY

PRIMETURN maintains a zero-tolerance approach to money laundering and other financial crimes.

Members are strictly prohibited from using our platform to:

  • Launder money.
  • Conceal the ownership or origin of funds.
  • Transfer funds obtained through illegal activities.
  • Conduct suspicious transactions intended to evade financial regulations.
  • Use another person's account to conduct unauthorised financial transactions.

PRIMETURN reserves the right to conduct identity verification, request supporting transaction documents, investigate suspicious activities and restrict accounts where reasonably necessary.

Such actions shall be undertaken in accordance with applicable Nigerian laws, including the Money Laundering (Prevention and Prohibition) Act 2022.

5. OFFICIAL PAYMENT INFORMATION

All payments for assets, purchases, deposits and other platform-related transactions must be made strictly to the official bank account details displayed within the PRIMETURN website or communicated through an officially verified PRIMETURN channel.

Members are strongly advised to:

  • Always verify the official account details before making payments.
  • Never transfer funds to personal accounts provided by individuals claiming to represent PRIMETURN.
  • Avoid making payments based on unofficial WhatsApp messages, social media messages or telephone instructions.
  • Never share their bank details, card information, PIN, OTP or passwords with anyone.
  • Always retain payment receipts and transaction references.

PRIMETURN shall not be responsible for payments voluntarily made to unauthorised third-party accounts that have not been officially designated by the platform, except where liability arises under applicable law.

Members should contact official PRIMETURN support whenever they are uncertain about payment instructions.

6. ACCOUNT SUSPENSION AND RESTRICTION

PRIMETURN reserves the right to temporarily restrict, suspend or permanently terminate an account where there are reasonable grounds to suspect:

  • Fraudulent activities.
  • Money laundering.
  • Unauthorised transactions.
  • False identity information.
  • Attempts to manipulate the platform.
  • Violation of these Terms and Conditions.
  • Any activity that exposes PRIMETURN, its members or financial partners to legal or security risks.

Depending on the circumstances, restricted accounts may be subjected to additional verification and investigation.

Where required by law, relevant information may be disclosed to appropriate authorities.

7. FORGOTTEN LOGIN OR REGISTRATION DETAILS

Members are responsible for keeping their registration and account recovery information safe.

If you forget your username, password, registration details or other account information, contact PRIMETURN through its officially designated customer support channels.

For security reasons, PRIMETURN may request additional information to verify your identity before assisting with account recovery.

Members must never give their login credentials to individuals claiming they can recover accounts on their behalf.

PRIMETURN shall not be responsible for losses resulting from unauthorised account recovery services or fraudulent individuals.

8. PURCHASES AND TRANSACTIONS

All purchases made on PRIMETURN must follow the platform's approved payment procedures.

Members are responsible for ensuring that:

  • They select the correct asset or service.
  • They enter accurate transaction information.
  • They pay the correct amount.
  • They use only approved payment channels.

PRIMETURN reserves the right to review, delay or reject transactions where there are reasonable concerns regarding fraud, payment irregularities or regulatory compliance.

9. MEMBER RESPONSIBILITIES

Every registered member agrees to use PRIMETURN responsibly and in accordance with applicable laws.

Members must not engage in activities that threaten the security, reputation, operations or financial integrity of the platform.

Members are also responsible for reviewing updates to these Terms and Conditions.

10. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

PRIMETURN shall take reasonable measures to maintain the security and reliability of its platform.

However, we shall not be held liable for losses resulting from circumstances beyond our reasonable control, including certain banking network failures, telecommunications interruptions, unauthorised third-party activities or force majeure events, except where liability cannot lawfully be excluded.

Nothing in these Terms and Conditions excludes any consumer or other legal rights that cannot be excluded under Nigerian law.

11. GOVERNING LAW

These Terms and Conditions shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

Any dispute arising from the use of PRIMETURN shall be addressed through appropriate dispute-resolution procedures and, where necessary, the competent courts in Nigeria.

12. ACCEPTANCE OF TERMS

By registering or continuing to use PRIMETURN, you acknowledge that you have read, understood and agreed to these Terms and Conditions.
